title: Annotatio VI §.V AD POSTERIUS: Word/Baptism need inward Spirit; Supper feeds the already-faithed
pass_a_gloss: In vain likewise it is excepted TO THE LATTER: that all men, by nature void of the Holy Spirit and every spiritual life, nevertheless become partakers of the Holy Spirit through the word outwardly preached and heard, and through water baptism administered to the body. Reply (a) Not the external preaching and hearing of the divine word alone, nor the external administration of baptismal water alone, but the inward operation of the Holy Spirit joined thereto regenerates human hearts and imbues them with saving spirituality. (b) The Holy Supper is not of the same reason as Word and Baptism — inasmuch as these serve to make a true and genuine Christian, that serves one already made and gifted with faith. Whence he who is not furnished with faith cannot become partaker of Christ’s body, food merely spiritual, and so cannot be corroborated and increased in faith by that very thing.
pass_b_english: AD POSTERIUS is futile: Word and baptism making Spirit-participants does not prove Impious can take spiritual body-food.

Inward Spirit-operation regenerates, not bare hearing or water alone; and the Supper is not same-ratio with Word/Baptism — those make a Christian, this feeds one already gifted with faith. Without faith there is no partaking, and no increase of faith by that food.
source_text: Frustra item AD POSTERIUS excipitur: Homines omnes, naturâ suâ, Spiritu Sancto omnique spirituali vitâ cassos, nihilominus Spiritûs Sancti fieri participes idque mediante verbô, extrinsecè prædicato auditóque, mediante item aquæ baptismate, corpori administrato. Resp. (a) Non solam externam verbi divini prædicationem ac auditionem, nec solam aquæ baptismalis externam administrationem, sed internam Spiritus S. operationem adjunctam, corda humana regenerare & spiritualitate salvifica imbuere. (b) Cœnam S. non esse cum Verbo & Baptismate, ejusdem rationis, quandoquidem hæc Christiano vero ac genuino efficiendo, ista, jam tum effecto fideque donato inserviunt. Unde qui fide non instructus, uti corporis Christi, cibi merè spiritualis, non potest fieri particeps, ita per illud ipsum in fide corroborari & augeri nequit.

lemmas.gloss: inward operation of the Holy Spirit
